stdlib.name: $floor
stdlib.doc: Materializes an exact product ratio as a uint256, rounding down once.

stdlib.name: $idiv
stdlib.doc: Performs one low-level uint256 division; division by zero returns zero.

stdlib.name: $sqrt
stdlib.doc: Returns floor(sqrt(value)) for one uint256 word.

stdlib.name: $keccak
stdlib.doc: Hashes zero or more complete uint256 words in source order.

stdlib.name: $bitnot
stdlib.doc: Returns the 256-bit bitwise complement of value.

stdlib.name: $readWords
stdlib.doc: Reads 1 to 8 selected raw return words in one static call. Indices must be increasing uint16 constants. Access the result with result[0], result[1], etc. Requires exact input ABI metadata; dynamic return offsets are not followed.

stdlib.name: $read
stdlib.doc: Reads from a contract. Args is an optional tuple.

stdlib.name: $write
stdlib.doc: Writes to a contract. The optional native value follows the ABI argument tuple; use {} for no arguments.

stdlib.name: $abiArgs
stdlib.doc: Uses one exact authenticated argument slice as a recursive ABI tape.

stdlib.name: $transferNative
stdlib.doc: Transfers native currency to one canonical address word; zero succeeds without calling it.

stdlib.name: $calli
stdlib.doc: Calls a nested interaction by id with optional args.

stdlib.name: $staticLinked
stdlib.doc: Runs one linked artifact in the authenticated read-only subject context.

stdlib.name: $valueUsd
stdlib.doc: Returns the exact ceiling USD18 value for a token amount.

stdlib.name: $nativeValueUsd
stdlib.doc: Returns the exact ceiling USD18 value for a native amount.

stdlib.name: $subjectArg
stdlib.doc: Reads a bounds-checked original interaction argument.

stdlib.name: $address
stdlib.doc: Resolves a registry id or hash to an address.

stdlib.name: $price
stdlib.doc: Fetches the token price; maxAge is an optional caller ceiling on the Registry heartbeat.

stdlib.name: $balance
stdlib.doc: Reads native balance for an owner or ERC20 balanceOf(owner) for a token.

stdlib.name: $deadline
stdlib.doc: Returns the current time plus the validity window.

stdlib.name: $slip
stdlib.doc: Applies the slippage factor to a value.

stdlib.name: $subjectPolicy
stdlib.doc: Authenticated policy selected for the root interaction.

templates.label: Send ETH to approved recipient
templates.description: Send $arg2 wei to $arg0; $arg1 carries the recipient policy mask.

templates.label: Send USDC to approved recipient
templates.description: Send $arg2 raw USDC units to $arg0; $arg1 carries the recipient policy mask.

templates.label: Uniswap V2 ETH to USDC
templates.description: Swap $arg0 wei with a 1 percent oracle bound.
templates.source:
let amountIn = $arg0
and router = @contract(uniswap/v2router)
and WETH = @token(weth/weth)
and USDC = @token(circle/usdc)
and amountOutMin = $floor(amountIn * $price(WETH, 6, 86400) * 99 / ($price(USDC, 18, 86400) * 100))
in $require(router.swapExactETHForTokens{value: amountIn}(amountOutMin, [WETH, USDC], $self, $deadline()))

templates.label: Uniswap V2 ETH to USDC, bips
templates.description: Swap $arg0 wei; $arg1 is slippage in basis points, capped at 100.
templates.source:
let amountIn = $arg0
and slippageBips = $arg1
and router = @contract(uniswap/v2router)
and WETH = @token(weth/weth)
and USDC = @token(circle/usdc)
and amountOutMin = $floor(amountIn * $price(WETH, 6, 86400) * (10000 - slippageBips) / ($price(USDC, 18, 86400) * 10000))
in {$require(slippageBips <= 100), $require(router.swapExactETHForTokens{value: amountIn}(amountOutMin, [WETH, USDC], $self, $deadline()))}

templates.label: Uniswap V2 USDC to WETH
templates.description: Swap $arg0 raw USDC units with a 1 percent oracle bound and clear the approval.
templates.source:
let amountIn = $arg0
and asset = @token(circle/usdc)
and output = @token(weth/weth)
and router = @contract(uniswap/v2router)
and amountOutMin = $floor(amountIn * $price(asset, 18, 86400) * 99 / ($price(output, 6, 86400) * 100))
in {
  $require(asset.approve(router, amountIn)),
  $require(router.swapExactTokensForTokens(amountIn, amountOutMin, [asset, output], $self, $deadline())),
  $require(asset.approve(router, 0)),
}

templates.label: USDC to ETH to Lido
templates.description: Swap $arg0 raw USDC units with a 1 percent oracle bound, clear the approval, and stake the ETH received.

templates.label: Lido submit

templates.label: Uni V3 mint USDC/ETH
templates.description: Mint from account USDC and native ETH, returning unused ETH to the account.

templates.label: Uni V3 mint USDC/USDT
templates.description: Mint a six-decimal stablecoin position with one-tick spacing.

templates.label: Aave V3 borrow with liquidity postcheck
templates.description: Borrow $arg0 wei of WETH only if at least $arg1 wei remains in the reserve afterward. This absolute cash floor can reject a liquidity-removing front-run; it does not cap the borrowing rate.
